newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks hit another record close.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks hit another record close.

text.p: * Toronto's key stock index hit 20th record close of the year on Thursday as gold bullion prices firmed, pushing gold ssues higher. * 92 million shares traded worth C$1.4 billion.
Toronto's stock market posted its 20th record close of the year on Thursday amid soaring gold issues as bullion prices bounced back from recent lows.

The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index added 18.31 points to close at 6592.92, inching above its old record of 6588.04 on July 3. But the index failed to break its all-time high of 6615.35 set the same day.
Gold bullion prices have danced around 12-year lows, rebounding on Thursday by US$1.90 to US$320.80 on Comex and buoying Toronto's influential golds, Fred Ketchen said.
